newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Junior Kiwis thump Papua New Guinea in NZ match.
newsitem.headline: Junior Kiwis thump Papua New Guinea in NZ match.

text.p: The New Zealand rugby league Junior Kiwis thumped their Papua New Guinea counterparts 76-0 (half-time 40-0) in their test at the International Stadium at Rotorua on Saturday.
The Junior Kiwis scored 14 tries with halfback Hare Te Rangi scoring a hat trick.
Centre David Kidwell, captain and prop Robert Henare and winger Leslie Vainikolo scored two tries each.
Centre Pai Savea kicked nine goals and scored a try for a personal tally of 22 points.
The New Zealand team lead 40-0 at halftime and impressively maintained their discipline through the second half.

Scorers: New Zealand Juniors 76. Tries: Hare Te Rangi (3), David Kidwell (2), Robert Henare (2), Leslie Vainikolo (2), Darren Hewitt, Frank Wagene, Pai Savea, Charlie Kennedy, Shane Beyers. Goals: Pai Savea (9), Gareth Cook goal.
